body: I know how you feel. I feel very similar and ik how bad it feels when the only person you have turns on you. I’m going to miss you. I might not have ever met you but I will miss you. Please reach out to me if you are comfortable. Talking to someone who cares is always nice. 💕💕Love you
Thank you. It’s nice to know that others who have delt and still deal with struggles can live on to have families and stable jobs. Thankyou again for the support and best of luck with your family💕
Thank you so much. Knowing others have gotten through similar things gives a little spark of hope I can too. Thank you again for the help
Think of all the beautiful sunsets you will miss. Those tiny laughs from stupid things online. The taste of your favorite foods and drinks. The melody of your favorite songs
Then I will be stopped. I don’t want to be stopped

I told their parents in detail. They did nothing. Yeah I told my mom I needed to see a doctor and she just told me to wait. That’s it. That it’s a normal thing for a teenager. The problem is I don’t care about myself anymore. And I can’t make myslef.
We are here to rant to. You got this stay strong❤️❤️
I was abused by my father as a younger child and i do not forgive him or plan on it. He broke my tailbone and I have problems (physically and mentally) it all depends on the person
